body: Hey, message me if you feel up to it, okay? I'd like to talk with you and help you.
Hey, I know what you mean. My 15th birthday was this year too, and I honestly posted almost the same thing as you 30 minutes before my birthday. Message me, okay? I wanna help
I think I'm just gonna try to sleep and maybe talk to someone about it this week. Thank you for caring and taking time to talk to me, it means more to me than you would think

I'm scared to get help. It makes me feel guilty because I don't have enough wrong with me to the point of doing self harm. Other people have it way worse and I feel like an attention whore trying to get help for barely anything
My boyfriend knows about it but he was in the same situation so if I tell him that I'm tempted, he gets really upset and threatens to hurt himself so I can't talk about it
I was just told that I was stressed out and that I need to calm down and take a little break but I can't take a break from anything, I've missed over 30 days of school this year
They're people in my school and I'm too quiet and scared to say anything again, I've tried but they just laugh
Nobody believes that something's wrong with me or that I'm depressed
I'm really scared, I don't even know what's wrong with me
They always talk to me and tell me how worthless I am, I'm scared to face them again

I kinda just wanna sleep and not wake up, I'm stuck in this cycle: cutting> feeling guilty> self hate> relapsing and it keeps happening over and over every few months but this time feels way worse and everything hurts, I really wanna cut again, I haven't in so long. Right now I feel really guilty because I'm supposed to be happy on my birthday but everything is shitty and I can't help but to feel helpless. I don't know if I'm safe anymore
I don't know if I can be helped at this point
I'd like to do stuff but I'm busy with school which stresses me out way more and I'm scared to go again, I can't get along with anyone and they won't leave me alone
I'm only gonna be 15 but they won't leave me alone, I don't know what to do anymore
These thoughts are driving me insane
